summary: Tronox Holdings plc filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026, announcing that its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.05 per share, payable July 8, 2026, to holders of record May 11, 2026. The filing is a routine dividend declaration with no special-situation elements such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or other corporate event. No deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics are involved. This is a standard current report reflecting ordinary dividend policy, not a special situation requiring further analysis.
